maxDataSeconds.description: The seconds after the question in which the loop may still call a tool; 1 to 60, default 20 (T-4294).

connectors.description: The Endpoints of this project whose MCP tools it may call.

disclaimer.description: The line under the chat that says answers are machine-written, per language.

feedback.description: Whether the chat shows the helpful/unhelpful buttons under an answer; default true.

languages.description: The languages it answers in, as ISO 639-1 codes.

model.description: The router and answer models; the service's default when absent.

sources.description: The `KnowledgeSource`s it answers from: one of this project by its name, one of a project in `scope.projects` as `{project}/{source}` (T-4281).

widget.description: How the chat picks its language and whether it shows the toggle (T-4343).
